facts.text: PostHog is an open-source platform for building software products.
PostHog operates as a fully remote company with staff distributed internationally across more than 20 countries.
PostHog was part of Y Combinator's Winter 2020 batch and has raised funding from Stripe, GV, and Y Combinator.
PostHog announced updated events data retention for new paid plans, lowering default retention to 2 years from 7 years.
PostHog announced that select event properties will be retained for only 60 days before deletion to accelerate query performance.
PostHog core framework and application technologies include Django, React, and TypeScript.
PostHog utilizes Docker Compose alongside PostgreSQL and ClickHouse for managing its core data stack.
PostHog runs background AI sandboxed agents inside isolated cloud containers with access to codebase execution and data.
PostHog views scaling its data pipeline as its primary challenge while distributing pipeline ownership to autonomous small teams.
PostHog finds scaling an engineering organization harder than scaling sales due to high coordination complexity and overlapping work.
PostHog faces complexity maintaining consistency across multiple product comparison matrices against market alternatives.
